newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr strengthens against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr strengthens against the dollar.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr marginally strengthened against the dollar on Monday, the central National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) said.
It quoted the birr at a mean rate of 6.6010 against the dollar compared to 6.6430 last week.
The bank said following a currency auction on April 5, the applicable rate for all transactions outside the auction in the April 7 to 12 period would be 6.6010 birr to the dollar.
The bank posted the pound at a mean rate of 10.8190 against the pound from 10.9357 last week, while against the yen, the birr traded at 0.053388 from 0.054383 last week.
